selection.summary: Fix #1241: in ZSTD_window_update (lib/compress/zstd_compress_internal.h), the non-contiguous branch sets window->base = ip - distanceFromBase, so on first usage of a context (base == NULL, distanceFromBase == 0) the first input position is 0, which is invalid for a match. Applied patch: when distanceFromBase == 0, start the reference at 1 by setting window->base = ip - 1 and window->dictLimit = 1, keeping base/dictBase/dictLimit consistent for subsequent index arithmetic. Handles h19/h20/h0/h24/h21/h22 cover ZSTD_window_update and adjacent window/index helpers in zstd_compress_internal.h used to locate and validate the change; other listed entries (adapt.c, cover.c, matchfinders) are unrelated to this window-logic fix.
